tools.name: civitai_search_models
tools.description: Search civitai.com for models (LoRA by default) and SHOW THE USER A PICKER: each result becomes a card with cached example images, base model, trigger words, download count and a Download button. Use this for any 'find / search / recommend a LoRA (or checkpoint) on civitai' request instead of running civitai.py by hand. Returns a numbered summary you can refer to; the user picks which one to download.

query.description: Search text, e.g. 'school uniform illustrious'. Put the base model name (Illustrious, Pony, SDXL, Flux) in the query to narrow results.

types.description: Model type: LORA (default), Checkpoint, TextualInversion, LoCon, DoRA, Hypernetwork, Controlnet.

sort.description: Default is relevance; 'Most Downloaded' is a good choice for popular picks.

tag.description: Only models with this civitai tag.

nsfw.description: Include NSFW models; omit to use civitai's default.

cursor.description: Continue from a previous result's next_cursor.
